published_prior_art.cite: BerkBrownBujaZhangZhao2013 gives generic simultaneous post-selection coverage, not exact-zero donor-face ATT profiling.
BerkBrownBujaZhangZhao2013 establishes the generic simultaneity-versus-precision tradeoff; this is its donor-face fixed-separation specialization.
EvansHansenStark2005 supplies the general Bayes-minimax confidence-set duality; the two-state likelihood-ratio formula is a specialized application.
Generic simultaneity-cost comparisons in BerkBrownBujaZhangZhao2013 motivate the calculation; the displayed two-state number is a specialized benchmark.
AndrewsKitagawaMcCloskey2024 treats winner-selected effects and EvansHansenStark2005 treats fixed restricted parameters, not a target indexed by zero-score faces with intersection coherence.
AndrewsCheng2014 and AndrewsMikusheva2016 give weak-identification uniform inference, but not the proposed deficiency and unbounded-diameter-risk transfer.

novelty_flags.label: Open-ended Question 2 (uniform experiment equivalence)
novelty_flags.one_line: The comparison omits the asymptotic-equivalence literature, especially Nussbaum's Gaussian-experiment work, which is more methodologically proximal than the two weak-identification papers.

soundness_flags.label: ass:additive-untreated-change and def:panel-model-class
soundness_flags.one_line: The condition is asserted at every support point g although a conditional expectation is only defined almost surely without a specified regular conditional version; state it P_G-almost surely or supply a version.

soundness_flags.label: def:profile-intervals, def:shared-covariance-estimator, and thm:uniform-coverage
soundness_flags.one_line: The construction inverts estimated covariance blocks that may be singular with positive finite-sample probability, but provides neither a fallback rule nor a theorem that makes the construction defined on all samples.

soundness_flags.label: prop:maximum-hull-gap
soundness_flags.one_line: The asserted maximum-critical hull is not defined in the two-score switch experiment: def:projected-hull profiles noisy score-effect blocks, whereas the switch experiment observes scores only; define the exact benchmark kernel before assigning it r_max.

soundness_flags.label: oeq:uniform-experiment-equivalence
soundness_flags.one_line: The unrestricted raw-data experiment is indexed by arbitrary group laws, while the proposed Gaussian experiment is indexed only by (h,b,Omega); neither a common parameter map nor convergence of b_j,n and Omega_n is specified, and fourth moments alone cannot identify a full-experiment deficiency equivalence.

soundness_flags.label: ass:nonempty-close-set
soundness_flags.one_line: Exact population score equality is load-bearing for the CMS interpretation, but the justification only says it would hold if an administratively specified stack exactly calibrated unknown population means and offers no realistic construction or external source for that premise.

source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The paper constructs projection intervals for a winner-selected effect and states that projection is valid without restrictions on selection but can be longer than conditional or hybrid intervals.

source_verification_receipts.version: Technical Report 617, revised 2003; corroborating prepublication version of the cited Bernoulli 11(4) article
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The paper formulates minimax expected-measure confidence sets for a general measurable restricted parameter space and derives Bayes-minimax duality through likelihood-ratio acceptance regions.

source_verification_receipts.version: Author version corresponding to Annals of Statistics 41(2), 2013
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The paper reduces universal post-selection validity to simultaneous inference over candidate submodels and notes the resulting conservatism.
The paper establishes GMM estimator, test, and confidence-set behavior over a full range of drifting identification-strength sequences, including uniform asymptotic sizes.
The paper introduces a Gaussian sufficient statistic for a functional nuisance parameter and conditional tests with uniformly correct asymptotic size.

source_verification_receipts.version: Review of Economics and Statistics 101(3), 2019, pp. 452–467
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The paper develops few-treated, many-control difference-in-differences inference under heteroskedasticity caused by unequal group sizes.

source_verification_receipts.version: Journal of Political Economy, ahead of print, 2026
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The article is titled Debiasing and t-Tests for Synthetic Control Inference on Average Causal Effects and develops cross-fitted bias correction with self-normalized t inference under stationary and nonstationary data.

strengthening_paths.suggestion: Define a total fallback for singular estimated covariance blocks, then prove its use is uniformly asymptotically negligible under the stated moment and eigenvalue conditions.

Replace pointwise conditional-mean language with an almost-sure version and state a concrete administrative calibration source or sampling design under which an exact-close stack can plausibly be formed.
Define the two-score maximum-critical benchmark as an explicit confidence kernel and prove that it is the precise switch-experiment image of the panel hull before retaining the numerical gap.

Recast the Le Cam target as either a reduced sample-mean experiment with a specified parameter map or a genuinely restricted LAN family, add convergence assumptions for b and Omega, and survey Nussbaum-style asymptotic-equivalence results.

recommended_next_step: Revise the undefined covariance and switch-kernel constructions, make the transport and experiment-equivalence regimes mathematically explicit, and strengthen the exact-close application premise before Stage 0.
